summary: Frontend-only regression after date-fns downgrade ^4.1.0 → ^3.6.0 (to satisfy react-day-picker@8.10.1 peer dep). Verified installed versions: date-fns@3.6.0, react-day-picker@8.10.1. Homepage, PDP (/product/pista-plain-roasted), and Admin (/admin) all render clean. Admin subscribers Subscribed date column formats correctly via native toLocaleString('en-IN', ...) — example row rendered as '9 Jun 2026, 2:34 pm'. Zero page errors, zero console errors, zero date-fns / react-day-picker related errors. Note: react-day-picker is only imported by unused components/ui/calendar.jsx (no other file consumes it), so no runtime surface for the peer-dep change.
critical_code_review_comments: date-fns is not actually imported anywhere in src/ — only react-day-picker is (in components/ui/calendar.jsx). date-fns lives in package.json purely as a transitive peer for react-day-picker@8.x. If neither date-fns nor Calendar is used at runtime, both are candidates for removal to shrink bundle.
components/ui/calendar.jsx is dead code (no consumers found via grep). Safe to remove alongside react-day-picker dep if not planned for future use.
